overseer.evidence: P.5 had not added fabric_bf16 (settings.py CCL_IMPL choices were stock / fabric); P.6 added it in tt/settings.py / tt/ccl.py and timed stock / fabric / fabric_bf16 per op (BREADCRUMBS P.6)

used.how: fabric_bf16 uses fabric_reduce_scatter's default FPU add (exact_fp32_add off) on bf16 partials; fabric keeps exact_fp32_add=True
the bf16 RS uses the same rs_links(mesh) link count and cache_descriptors=True as the exact path
the sums the fork cannot take stay the exact all_gather + SFPU add; a bf16 partial reaching that path is cast to fp32 first

missing: a bf16 reduce-scatter fed by a separate fp32->bf16 typecast is slower than the exact fp32 RS on a TP-2 box; the producer must write bf16 (now DS41-67)
